rules.scope: Six bounded authoritative snapshots (three existing fixtures, live/offline). No full test suite, game math replacement, browser, disk save, remote action, tracked edit, or modified fixture file.
rules.seed: Existing fixture fields, placeholder dates hydrated with existing harness day and fixed clock, then production acceptPersistedState. Only purchase queue flags are overridden OFF in memory; Auto-Ascend/paid levels remain unchanged.
rules.priceAnchor: Fresh-state production enemyRewardFor(unlockDepth-1,false) * 1000 for Lumen and shardRewardFor(unlockDepth-1,false) * 500 for Shards, then ceil to multiples of 1000 / 100. These are non-boss, non-Luminous depths; neutral reward modifiers equal 1.
rules.rounding: Production rounds each normal kill payout first. With 1000/500 multipliers, the requested final 1000/100 rounding is then a no-op. A separately labelled alternative before per-kill rounding exposes that design choice; it is not the primary price rule.
rules.gains: summary lumenGained/shardGained are actual gross engine gains, including ability rewards. NetCurrencyDelta is final minus initial wallet. No manual taps, purchases, or altered health/depth are added. Existing saved enemy HP is retained.
rules.interpretation: Affordability is a current-wallet arithmetic comparison, with unlock eligibility separate. A 60-second gross-output ratio is not time to unlock, time to afford, a projected sustained rate, or a representative player progression claim.
rules.offline: Uses advanceAuthoritativeTime kind offline and its production earning scale/retreat policy; does not invoke cold-return storage workflow or count totalOfflineSeconds bookkeeping.
